What has been shocking to hear about Yemen, beyond the Dark Veils in crowded streets, beyond the Drums, Songs and Dances on Special Occasions, beyond the family expectations that invariably run high, the Economic Divide is enormous!
Yemeni Women and Children's lives , both carry, often enormous hidden pressures  behind many different doors. It is a case of daily survival amid Poverty, Insecurity, school  closures , fear of violence, protecting Family , these such circumstances can also push young women into unwanted early marriages, how sad this is amongst other issues.
When overall Survival for most Yemeni' People is mostly dependant on  finding and carrying Water, preparing meals , protecting families  through all sorts of Challenges that most of us in other parts of the World could not even begin to comprehend!Such Struggles that appear to be part and parcel of the way of Life for Yemeni People !
With.17 million people facing FOOD Insecurity!!!
And 18 million people who lack Safe Water for basic everyday living, o. Top of major lack of safe Sanitation Facilities , this is absolutely shocking! With already Major Problems concerning Malnutrition!!! What else
Can One Say...to Stress the Importance of Finding some way to Help the Yemeni People!
It also seems to be that around 41% of the total population is under 15 years old. If People of all Ages do Not have adequate Water and decent Food their overall Health and General Well Being is going to be overtime , severely impacted!l 
If Most Yemeni' People have only known wars, then isn't about time, that these Wars stopped! Interestingly there are 2 Calendars in Yemen, that shape every  day Life, the Gregorian calendar that guides business , travel and International Communications and the Islamic Calender that covers Ramadan , Religious Ceremonies/Special Events and Important Family Occassions. (Measuring one part of Life by the Sun and the other by the Moon.) Most Yemeni People , as it would seem to be, they are naturally incredibly resourceful , thoughtful and giving from their Hearts, when You enter into their more intimate ways of Life, their circles of warmth, their treasured and maybe Not so treasured memories ? Yemeni hospitality and the language of Family speak volumes when they Trust in you, should you be fortunate to share a meal, you are not only being fed , you are being accepted despite most of Yemeni People being truly poor , they give their Guests "Special Attention!" A Stranger who enters a Yemini  Home should not leave disappointed. ( How Beautiful is that!) Amidst the Shadows of Decades of Wars that have stolen lives and livelihoods and continues to steal Childhoods !
 This is the Tragedy,
 but there is Hope, there is Belief, the question is...can Yemen Rise Again ? When some Borders do Not mean nor guarantee Entry, when Access to Basic Needs  Does Not Mean Steady Supply
This appears to relate to all Basic Essential NEEDS -such as shrinking availability of potable, drinkable Water Sources , increased Food Shortages, inadequate Shelters, inconsistent readily available Doctors and Medicines, No Energy for running  Lighting or Fridges etc, or very limited Energy E.g Solar etc, which can often be unreliable!
And Thats not All, out there in a quiet field there are the remnants of previous wars buried ,
One wrong Step can mean " Kabooom!"
